ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: the figure is an overlapping comparison map of the geographical locations of China and the United States, with the same scale; on the figure there are latitude lines such as 20°, 30°, 40°, and 50°, as well as a central line labeled 100°E/W. Place A is located in the mid-latitudes of the Northern Hemisphere, roughly between 30°—40°N, near the 100°E/W central line, and is in the central inland position of the mainland United States. Reasoning: the central inland region of the United States is relatively far from the ocean and is weakly regulated by the ocean, so the continentality of the climate is significant. According to the distribution of world climate types, this region corresponds to a temperate continental climate. Conclusion: the climate type of place A in the figure is temperate continental climate.

<image1>

What is the climate type of place A in the figure?

method.method_draft: 读题可知这是中、美同尺度地理位置重叠图，需要判断图中A地气候类型。先在图上用纬线和100°E/W中线定位A：A在北半球中纬度、美国本土中部内陆附近。再调用世界气候分布知识：美国中部内陆受海洋影响较弱，属于温带大陆性气候。因此答案为温带大陆性气候。
method.CoT_raw: 图像描述：图中为中国与美国地理位置重叠对照图，比例尺相同；图上有20°、30°、40°、50°等纬线以及标注为100°E/W的中线。A地位于北半球中纬度，大致在30°—40°N之间，靠近100°E/W中线，处在美国本土中部内陆位置。推理：美国中部内陆地区距离海洋较远，受海洋调节作用较弱，气候大陆性显著。根据世界气候类型分布，该区域对应温带大陆性气候。结论：图中A地的气候类型是温带大陆性气候。
